note: P4119 (Pro 19:23) — the fear of the LORD leads to life; whoever has it rests satisfied, untouched by harm. (ra 'harm' = standalone.)

dims.v: fear of the LORD — which leads to life and rest
the fear of the LORD that leads to life, and lets a man rest satisfied, untouched by harm
the reverence that yields life, contentment, and safety

yirah (fear) — 'the fear of the LORD leads to LIFE, and whoever has it rests satisfied; he will not be visited by harm'; reverence gives life, contentment, and security. The read holds the threefold fruit — life, restful satisfaction, and safety — of the fear of God.
